scope: Quest-prop chest editing, saved closed state, grade selection and durable reward cycles
causes: The editor only forced the lid closed while the old once-only reward token still disabled interaction.
Built-in quest chest handles and the actor editor had no tier property or tier control.
changes: A closed editor application re-arms a previously claimed chest once using a separate reward-cycle token and drop ID.
Original quest facts, owned items and uncollected drops are preserved; map reload/reconnect cannot re-arm the same cycle.
Saved legacy visual-only closed overrides are migrated once.
Actor editing supports all five tiers; selected tier updates the existing per-instance outline colour and is saved with reward settings.
Cancel restores the original tier and lid state without resetting rewards; changing only grade does not re-arm an opened chest.
limitations: Node DOM/NullEngine verifies CPU logic, saved state, actual lid matrices and resource ownership.
No browser automation, hardware rasterization, device FPS or thermal claim.
